# ASCII sharks

Source: https://github.com/stackedlol/ascii-sharks

Pinned revision: `a0074c16a106f0abc665fe9712ca445f8f98ad8e`

The four TypeScript modules are copied unchanged apart from the first-line `ts-nocheck` directive. Upstream does not enable Daily's unchecked-index diagnostics. The renderer and simulation retain the original arithmetic, behavior and comments. Daily owns lifecycle and responsive integration in `web/lib/ocean-controller.ts` and `web/lib/ocean-scene.ts`.
